title: CAD #27-041188 — Hollow Creek Gate "Stuck Open"

fields.location: HOLLOW CREEK OUTLET, LEVEE AND DRAINAGE DISTRICT NO. 3 LEVEE, HOLLOW RD, CEDAR FORD

narrative.author: CT14
narrative.text: RP ON HOLLOW RD ADV HOLLOW CREEK FLOOD GATE IS "STUCK OPEN" AND RIVER IS RUNNING BACKWARDS INTO DITCHES BEHIND LEVEE

narrative.author: CT14
narrative.text: RP STS "THE WHOLE FIELD BY THE OUTLET IS FILLING UP, IT'S COMING IN FROM THE RIVER"

narrative.author: CT14
narrative.text: RP IS ON SCENE, STANDING ON LEVEE CROWN. NO INJ REPORTED. NO VEHS OR STRUCTURES IN WATER PER RP

narrative.author: CT14
narrative.text: RP DOES NOT KNOW WHO RUNS THE GATE. ADV RP WE WILL HAVE SOMEONE CONTACT HIM. CALLBACK GOOD

narrative.author: CT14
narrative.text: RIVER AT CFDI4 14.8 FT PER EOC 0700 UPDATE. FWD TO DISP

narrative.author: D07
narrative.text: DO WE PAGE OUT FIRE FOR A LEVEE PROBLEM? HOLDING FOR FIELD OPS / LEVEE DIST DIRECTION

instructorNote: This is a red herring that tests verify-before-responding: Field should ask the Levee District to send patrol L-2 rather than page a fire response, and the PIO should log the claim for the rumor log. Hand this out at 07:10. At 07:16, read the L-2 radio call from the MSEL row aloud: the gate is seated and closed, there is no flow, the water is clear, still rain ponding, and a man is standing on the crown.
